findings.evidence: Native later-cohort evaluation/selection approved a ranker highlighting20 repeated decisions from one winning mint:84 rows,65 distinct mints,5 positive mints, precision1 and row lift3.5. Initial assertion failed in2.96s with bootstrap_validated_scanner_ranker.
findings.risk: Row-weighted diagnostics and total distinct-positive support can hide concentrated ranking utility. This is a demonstrated software approval defect, not an observed loss or missed live trade.
findings.repair: One token mean of selected-positive utility, compared with a same-capacity uniform baseline and a positive lower historical token-cluster gain. Retain row precision/recall/lift as diagnostics.

findings.evidence: Previous challenger/incumbent selection compared only row precision-lift points on the same later cohort. It did not require a paired token-level improvement check.
findings.risk: A few lucky decision rows can replace a useful advisory incumbent; a broader signal can also be hidden by a perfect row metric dominated by repeats.
findings.repair: Compare current token-capture lift with unchanged numerical minimum delta, require positive lower paired token gain, bind comparison to the same original cohort hash and reuse the exact evaluated score vectors.

method.utility: For binary target y and original exact-boundary selection weight w, captured-positive utility is y*w. Uniform baseline utility is y*k/n; an incumbent uses its own original same-capacity exact-boundary weights.
method.aggregation: Mean utility and paired baseline-minus-model loss improvement per case-sensitive trimmed mint. Repeated rows remain decisions, not additional bootstrap units.
method.selection_lift: Mean captured-positive utility across tokens divided by mean same-budget uniform-baseline utility. This is not row precision, calibrated probability or financial capture ratio.
method.uncertainty: Reuse existing deterministic1000-sample token-cluster bootstrap, seed781 and lower quantile0.05, in50-sample batches. Cutoffs are held fixed at observed label-independent top-k values; token/time independence and future coverage remain unproved.
method.admission: Current generation, complete finite observed truth/predictions/identities, at least30 tokens and5 positive token supports, capture lift>=1.25 and positive lower historical gain. Challenger replacement additionally needs current same-cohort paired improvement and the configured minimum lift delta.
method.legacy: Preserve legacy weights/metadata/selector history on disk. They are neutral for current scalar/batch ranking until an independently validated current-generation successor exists; incompatible rollback is refused. Calibrated probability readiness is independent.
method.metadata_contract: Current version/method/grain, exact bootstrap budget/quantile, typed token support and finite coherent capture/baseline/lift/gain are required. This is calculation lineage, not independent full-process/financial attestation.
